--- sitemap: false layout: null --- {% raw %} LMs and Experts

How the LMs respond to users seeking personal advice, next to what the agent-experts say they should do

997 vignettes (run argon_n1000, 2026-11-04). Three LMs answered each one: Gemini 4 Argon, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol. Five agent-experts (Gemini 4 Argon, one per school of thought) said what the response should do. Every response was described on the same response dimensions: its stance on the user's actions, its stance on the user's framing, and which of nine emotional support tactics it uses. Orange is the LMs' responses; blue is the agent-experts. The earlier version of this page (576 vignettes, five LMs, Opus experts, Flash judge) is at figures576.
